definitions.explanation: Of superior quality or craftsmanship. Used to describe products, services, and materials that meet a high standard.

examples.japanese: {高品質|こうひんしつ}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高品質|こうひんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{低価格|ていかかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧だ。
examples.english: This store's selling point is high quality at low prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本製|にほんせい}→日本製：28455_nihonsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高品質|こうひんしつ}だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まっている→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: The reputation that Japanese-made products are high quality has spread worldwide.

notes:
{高品質|こうひんしつ} describes products, services, or materials of superior quality. Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective.

FORMS:
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: high-quality materials (modifier)
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for high quality (noun)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}・{低価格|ていかかく}: high quality, low price
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain high quality
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: high-quality product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低品質|ていひんしつ}→低品質：23685_teihinshitsu⟧: low quality (opposite)
- ⟦{上質|じょうしつ}→上質：20493_joushitsu⟧: fine quality (emphasizes elegance and refinement rather than technical superiority)
- ⟦{良質|りょうしつ}→良質：13949_ryoushitsu⟧: good quality (slightly less emphatic than {高品質|こうひんしつ})
